title: Finishing Engineer - Luxurious Residence Project
description:
Job Description – Finishing Engineer

Location: Mumbai, Santacruz

Department: Projects / Construction

Industry: Real Estate – High-Rise Residential Development

Experience: 10 -12 Years in Finishing

working for Luxurious Residential projects

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Objective

We are looking for an experienced Finishing Engineer to manage and execute finishing works for premium high-rise residential projects in Mumbai.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring superior workmanship, adherence to drawings and specifications, timely completion, coordination between multiple agencies, systematic snagging and possession-ready delivery of apartments and common areas.

The role requires strong on-site execution capabilities and a keen eye for finishing quality and detailing.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Finishing Works Execution**

\* Plan, supervise and execute all internal and external finishing activities.

\* Manage works including:

\* Blockwork and internal plaster

\* Waterproofing

\* Screeding and flooring

\* Marble, granite and tile works

\* Gypsum/plaster and false ceilings

\* Internal and external painting

\* Doors, frames and hardware

\* Aluminium/windows and glazing

\* Railings and metal works

\* Sanitary and CP fittings

\* Kitchen and utility finishes

\* Carpentry and joinery

\* Façade finishing interfaces

\* Common areas, lift lobbies and staircases

\* Entrance lobby and other premium finishes

\* External development and landscape interfaces

**2. Quality Control**

\* Ensure finishing works are executed strictly as per approved drawings, specifications, material approvals and established quality standards.

\* Inspect workmanship at every stage instead of identifying defects only at completion.

\* Check line, level, plumb, alignment, joints, slopes, surface finish, shade variations and overall aesthetics.

\* Ensure proper protection of completed finishes to prevent damage by subsequent agencies.

\* Establish and maintain benchmark/mock-up standards before commencement of repetitive finishing works.

\* Identify defective workmanship and ensure timely rectification.

**3. MEP & Services Coordination**

\* Coordinate finishing works with electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC, ELV and other service contractors.

\* Ensure all concealed services are inspected and approved before closing walls, ceilings, shafts or flooring.

\* Prevent rework arising from improper coordination between civil, finishing and MEP agencies.

**4. Planning & Contractor Management**

\* Prepare floor-wise and activity-wise finishing schedules in line with the overall project programme.

\* Monitor daily and weekly progress against targets.

\* Coordinate multiple contractors and vendors to maintain proper work sequence.

\* Assess manpower and material requirements in advance to avoid delays.

\* Conduct regular site coordination meetings and follow up on pending activities.

\* Verify contractor work quantities and assist in certification of bills where required.

**5. Drawings & Technical Coordination**

\* Study and implement architectural, interior, structural and MEP drawings.

\* Identify drawing discrepancies and constructability issues before execution.

\* Coordinate with architects, consultants and the project team for RFIs and technical clarifications.

\* Ensure only the latest approved drawings are being followed at site.

**6. Snagging & Possession Readiness**

\* Conduct systematic apartment-wise, floor-wise and common-area snagging.

\* Maintain snag lists with clear responsibility and closure timelines.

\* Carry out pre-handover inspections before units are offered for customer inspection.

\* Coordinate with CRM/Post-Sales teams for customer inspections and possession.

\* Ensure customer snags are attended to promptly and closed to the required quality standard.

\* Ensure flats are thoroughly checked, cleaned, functional and possession-ready before handover.

**7. Material Management**

\* Check incoming finishing materials for approved make, specification, shade and quality.

\* Monitor material consumption and minimise wastage.

\* Ensure appropriate storage and protection of high-value finishing materials.

\* Coordinate material requirements and delivery schedules with Procurement.

**8. Documentation & Reporting**

Maintain proper records of:

\* Daily progress

\* Quality inspections

\* Material approvals

\* Mock-up approvals

\* RFIs and drawing revisions

\* Snagging and closure status

\* Contractor performance

\* Floor-wise completion status

Provide regular progress and quality reports to the Project Manager/Management.

Candidate Profile

\* B.E./B.Tech Civil or Diploma in Civil Engineering

\* 10 + years of relevant experience, preferably with reputed developers or contractors executing high-rise residential projects in Mumbai.

\* Strong hands-on experience in premium residential finishing works.

\* Should have independently handled finishing of multiple floors/apartments through final possession.

\* Good understanding of architectural drawings, finishing details and MEP interfaces.

\* Strong knowledge of finishing materials, installation methodology and quality standards.

\* Ability to manage multiple contractors and large site teams.

\* Strong problem-solving and coordination abilities.

\* Extremely detail-oriented with a strong eye for workmanship, alignment, aesthetics and final presentation.

**Preferred Experience**

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

\* Worked on premium/luxury high-rise residential buildings

\* Managed finishing from bare shell through possession

\* Experience with sample/mock-up flats

\* Managed apartment and common-area snagging

\* Coordinated directly with architects and interior designers

\* Experience in customer handover and possession

\* Delivered projects with high-quality marble, stone, façade, lobby and interior finishes

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will primarily be measured on:

\* Finishing quality and workmanship

\* Floor-wise completion against schedule

\* Number of snags at internal inspection

\* Customer snags at possession

\* Snag closure turnaround time

\* Rework and material wastage

\* Contractor productivity

\* Protection of completed works

\* Readiness of apartments for possession

\* Quality of common areas and final project presentation

**Key Requirements:**

\* Strong experience in high-rise residential finishing

\* Expertise in flooring, marble/tiles, painting, gypsum, doors/windows, sanitary fittings & common-area finishes

\* Strong Civil–MEP coordination

\* Contractor & floor-wise execution management

\* Excellent eye for quality and detailing

\* Experience in snagging, possession readiness & customer handover

\* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil Engineering

Candidates who have independently handled finishing from civil completion to possession will be preferred.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

Application Question(s):

* How many years experience you have in Finishing?
* Where do you stay?
* What is your notice period?
* What is your current Salary?

Work Location: In person

title: Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer
description:
**Project Role :** Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer  
**Project Role Description :** Configure and support packaged or SaaS applications to adapt features, manage releases, and ensure system stability. Use standard tools, APIs, and low-code platforms to align solutions with business needs while preserving compatibility and performance.
  
**Must have skills :** SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting  
**Good to have skills :** NA  
Minimum **7.5** year(s) of experience is required  
**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  
  
Summary:
  
As a Packaged/SaaS Application Engineer, a typical day involves configuring and supporting packaged or software as a service applications to tailor features according to evolving business requirements. The role includes managing software releases and ensuring the overall stability and performance of the system. The engineer works with various tools, application programming interfaces, and low-code platforms to deliver solutions that align with organizational goals while maintaining compatibility across different environments. Collaboration with stakeholders to understand needs and adapt applications accordingly is a key part of daily activities, ensuring seamless operation and continuous improvement of the software landscape.  
  
Roles & Responsibilities:
  

* Lead end-to-end implementations of SAP Group Reporting across S/4HANA programs (On-Premises or Public Cloud)

Manage client workshops to define Group Reporting architecture, scope, and reporting requirements.  
Own solution architecture for legal/Management consolidation, intercompany elimination, COI (Consolidation of Investments), currency translation, and data collection  
Engage with senior finance stakeholders (CFO/Controllers) to capture requirements and provide advisory on consolidation process design and reporting  
Define and oversee configuration of master data elements (FS Items, Consolidation Units, Versions, Categories, Hierarchies)  
Manage integration of GR with S/4 Universal Journal (ACDOCA), GRDC, and external systems (via flat files or APIs)  
Govern the ICMR (Intercompany Matching and Reconciliation) process and integrate it into Data Monitor  
Deliver structured and ad-hoc reporting via Fiori apps, SAP Analysis for Office (AFO), and SAC  
  
Drive project documentation (Blueprints, Functional Specs, Test Scripts) and ensure traceability through UAT and deployment  
Lead project teams, mentor junior consultants (L10/L11), and ensure timely and quality delivery  
Support pre-sales activities, including effort estimation, solutioning, and proposal building  
  
Professional & Technical Skills:
  

* 8 years of Finance/overall experience including at least 3+ years of hands-on SAP Group Reporting implementation

Strong functional understanding of legal & management consolidation, accounting principles, IC reconciliation, and financial close processes  
Hands-on experience in:  
o Data Monitor & Consolidation Monitor  
o Legal consolidation processes i.e Data collection, Currency translation, Elimination, reclassification and other processes  
o ICMR configuration and execution  
o GRDC forms and flat file templates  
o SAC integration for consolidated reporting  
Experience in at least 3+ full lifecycle implementations of SAP Group Reporting (S/4 On-premise or Public Cloud)  
Good exposure to SAP BPC and/or SAC Planning is an advantage  
SAP certification in Group Reporting or S/4HANA for Finance preferred  
  
Additional Information:
  

* The candidate should have minimum 7.5 years of experience in SAP S/4HANA Group Reporting.
* This position is based at our Mumbai office.
* A 15 years full time education is required.

  
15 years full time education

**4. Cost Estimation & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with internal policies, industry standards, and client requirements.
* Conduct quality checks on final submissions to guarantee accuracy and professionalism.
* Ensuring & Tracking of Bank Guarantee.

**5. Post-Submission Activities**

* Follow up on submitted tenders, addressing any additional questions or requests for clarification.
* Attend post-tender meetings or debriefings to understand the outcome and identify areas for improvement.

title: Front Desk Administrator
description:
Job Description (JD) – Front Desk Executive

**Company:** La Densitae Clinic Ltd.  
**Department:** Front Office / Clinic Operations  
**Job Title:** Front Desk Administrator  
**Location:** Panvel, Maharashtra  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Branch Manager / Clinic Manager

About La Densitae

La Densitae Clinic Ltd. is a specialized hair restoration and hair-loss treatment organization committed to delivering quality patient care and a professional healthcare experience. We are looking for a courteous, organized, and patient-focused Front Desk Executive to manage front-office operations and ensure a smooth experience for patients and visitors.

Job Summary

The Front Desk Executive will serve as the first point of contact for patients, visitors, and callers at the clinic. The role involves patient reception, appointment scheduling, handling inquiries, maintaining records, coordinating with internal teams, and supporting daily clinic operations while ensuring excellent customer service.

Roles and Responsibilities

* **Front Desk Management**
* Welcome patients and visitors professionally and ensure a positive first impression.
* Manage patient registration, check-ins, and appointment confirmations.
* Handle incoming calls, emails, and general inquiries efficiently.
* Maintain a professional, organized, and welcoming reception area.
* **Appointment & Patient Coordination**
* Schedule, reschedule, and confirm patient appointments.
* Coordinate with doctors, consultants, and clinic staff to manage patient flow.
* Inform patients about appointment timings and provide necessary pre-visit information.
* Follow up with patients regarding appointments and pending visits, as required.
* **Patient Service & Communication**
* Address patient queries politely and direct medical questions to the appropriate healthcare professional.
* Ensure a smooth and comfortable patient experience throughout the clinic visit.
* Handle patient concerns professionally and escalate complaints to the Branch Manager when necessary.
* Maintain confidentiality of patient information and clinic records.
* **Documentation & Record Management**
* Maintain accurate patient details, appointment records, and visit registers.
* Update patient information in the clinic's software or CRM system.
* Manage documentation, forms, and other front-office records.
* Ensure proper handling and storage of confidential patient documents.
* **Coordination & Administrative Support**
* Coordinate with the sales, consultation, medical, and operations teams.
* Support the Branch Manager with daily administrative activities and reports.
* Assist with billing coordination and payment documentation, wherever required.
* Monitor appointment schedules and help minimize waiting times.
* Follow company policies, standard operating procedures, and service-quality standards.

Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; candidates with a background in Hospital Administration, Healthcare Management, or Business Administration will be preferred.
* 0–3 years of experience in front desk operations, reception, customer service, or healthcare administration.
* Experience in a clinic, hospital, diagnostic center, or other healthcare facility will be an added advantage.
* Freshers with strong communication and customer-handling skills may also apply.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Professional, polite, and patient-focused approach.
* Basic computer proficiency, including MS Office, email, and data entry.
* Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and manage appointments efficiently.
* Strong coordination, problem-solving, and customer-service skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information responsibly.
* Fluency in English, Hindi, and Marathi will be preferred.

Working Conditions

* Work from the Thane clinic.
* Six-day working week with one weekly off, as per clinic schedule.
* Working hours will be as per clinic timings.
* The candidate must be comfortable working in a patient-facing healthcare environment.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Patient satisfaction and quality of front-desk service.
* Accuracy of patient records and appointment scheduling.
* Timely handling of calls and patient inquiries.
* Effective coordination with doctors and clinic teams.
* Reduction in appointment-related errors and patient waiting time.
* Compliance with clinic policies and documentation standards.

Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for a well-groomed, approachable, and service-oriented individual who can manage front-desk responsibilities efficiently, communicate confidently with patients, and contribute to the smooth functioning of clinic operations.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹20,000.00 per month

title: RCGTH - Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a Domain Consultant – RCGTH, you will make an impact by shaping compelling, insight\-led client propositions across Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality, translating client priorities into differentiated solution narratives, business cases, proposals, and thought leadership. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with sales, pre\-sales, consulting, solutioning, solution architects, practice leaders, account teams, delivery teams, alliance partners, and clients.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a domain strategist and trusted advisor to sales, business development, consulting, and solutioning teams, researching and synthesizing industry trends, client priorities, market shifts, competitor activity, and emerging technologies across the RCGTH portfolio.
  
Translate client business needs into domain\-led solution themes, capability maps, value propositions, transformation roadmaps, and proposal narratives.
  
Support opportunity qualification and pursuits by developing compelling content for proposals, RFP responses, pitch decks, executive presentations, solution storyboards, battle cards, and account\-specific point\-of\-view documents.
  
Shape differentiated go\-to\-market narratives and build reusable RCGTH assets such as industry trend summaries, value maps, use\-case libraries, case studies, reference architectures, and competitive positioning materials.
  
Contribute to practice development through thought leadership, market intelligence, and offering development, and mentor junior business development and pre\-sales associates.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Mumbai. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
10\-15\+ years of experience in domain consulting, business development, pre\-sales, industry advisory, digital transformation, or solution consulting, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Technology, Engineering, Information Systems, Marketing, or a related discipline.
  
Strong understanding of Retail, Consumer Goods, Travel, and Hospitality business models, value chains, customer journeys, operating models, and industry\-specific priorities.
  
Proven experience developing proposals, solution narratives, executive presentations, market research outputs, thought leadership, business cases, or go\-to\-market assets.
  
Familiarity with key RCGTH transformation themes and relevant enterprise platforms and technology ecosystems, including CRM, commerce, contact center, data and analytics, AI/GenAI, marketing technology, order management, ERP, and digital experience platforms.
  
Demonstrated ability to convert ambiguous client needs into structured problem statements, value propositions, and outcome\-oriented recommendations while collaborating across cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced, matrixed environment.
  
These will help you succeed
  
An MBA or equivalent consulting experience.
  
Familiarity with CRM and customer engagement technologies such as Salesforce (Sales, Service, Marketing, Experience, Data, and Commerce Cloud, and Agentforce), Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP Customer Experience, Adobe Experience Cloud, and ServiceNow Customer Service Management.
  
Awareness of emerging themes such as hyper\-personalization, omnichannel experience, connected loyalty, intelligent fulfillment, sustainable operations, AI\-enabled workforce, and unified customer intelligence.
  
Strong commercial acumen with the ability to articulate business value, support ROI narratives, and align proposed solutions to client priorities.
  
Excellent research, synthesis, writing, communication, and presentation skills, with confidence engaging senior sales, account, consulting, and client stakeholders.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: Domain Consultant
description:
Mumbai, Mahārāshtra, India Sales Ref ID: JR\-021899  

**Our Mission**


At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real\-world problems with cutting\-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you’re ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you’re in the right place.


**Who We Are**


In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real\-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!


We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real\-time problem\-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.
**Job Summary**


**Your Career**  



As a Domain Consultant for SOC Transformation you will be the expert for our Cortex portfolio, a Next\-Gen AI\-powered security operations platform. You will play a key role in defining technical solutions that secure a customer’s key business imperatives. You evangelize our industry leading solutions in Security Intelligence and Automation, XDR, Attack Surface Management, SOAR and Incident Response that establish Palo Alto Networks as a customer’s cybersecurity partner of choice.  

  



**Your Impact**  



* Collaborate with account teams to recommend and develop customer solutions within your assigned specialization area
* Present to customers as our expert at all levels in the customer hierarchy, from practitioner to senior leadership
* As the main technical point of contact for Cortex, you will assist and collaborate to respond effectively to RFIs/RFPs.
* Lead and support customer demonstrations that showcase our unique value proposition
* Scope and lead Proof of Value (PoV) projects for prospective customers and partners based on best practices to ensure technical win in your assigned opportunities
* Drive high technical validation and PoV win rates within your assigned specialization area
* Responsible for discussing and highlighting product alignment with customer requirements and differentiation
* Architect solutions that will help our customers strengthen and simplify their security posture
* Document High\-Level Design and Key Use Cases to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks Solutions
* Help our customers build and develop further their services around Cortex solutions
* Lead conversations about industry trends and emerging changes to the security landscape
* Discuss, with credibility, competitive offers in the marketplace and position ours as the best alternative
* Position Palo Alto Networks or Partner delivered services as appropriate to ensure proper implementation and value realization of Palo Alto Networks solutions
* Act as a conduit for customer feedback to Product Management, Technical Marketing, competitor intelligence, and R\&D to create requirements and deliver product features for our customers
  

  

**Qualifications**

  

  

**Your Experience**


* 5\+ years experience in Security Operations or pre\-sales/sales engineering within SIEM, SOAR, SOC, and/or XDR/EDR environments or graduate of Palo Alto Networks Academy Program
* IBM QRadar design, deployment, and/or pre\-sales experience highly desirable
* Experience in working with customers, demonstrating problem\-solving skills and a can\-do attitude
* Solid understanding of Security Operations Center processes
* Knowledge of SIEM and/or SOAR solutions
* Scripting experience is a plus \- Python preferred
* This is a field sales position where travel requirements may be required to support in person customer meetings, please discuss with the recruiter on the specifics for this position.
* Proficient in English
  

  

**The Team**


Our Domain Consultant team members work hand\-in\-hand with organizations around the world to keep their digital environments protected. We educate, inspire,and empower our potential clients in their journey to security.

  

  

You are empowered with unmatched systems and tools and a team built on joint success. You won’t find someone at Palo Alto Networks that isn’t committed to your success – with everyone pitching in to assist when it comes to solutions selling, learning, and development. Our Solutions Consulting community is driven by the mission to be our customers’ cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting their digital way of life.

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
